title: The Porch Light Flickers
ongoing: Until next Dawn: Charlie checks ignore Flashlights — only Fire counts as a light source.

title: Shadows Move Without Bodies
immediate: Each player rolls the Sanity d8 and loses Sanity equal to half (round up).

title: Food Goes Bad
immediate: Each player discards 1 Food from their resources.

title: A Basketball Bounces in the Dark
immediate: Spawn a Threat at the Basketball Court (draw face-down on tile).
art_notes: A ball bouncing in a moonlit empty court

title: Everyone's Hungrier Than They Should Be
ongoing: Until next Dawn: Rest restores no Hunger.

title: The Deerclops Approaches
immediate: Pre-warning. The Deerclops boss arrives next Dawn at the Basketball Court.

title: The Deerclops Arrives
immediate: Place the Deerclops standee on the Basketball Court. Doom +1.
ongoing: While Deerclops is on the map: All Sanity costs are doubled.

title: A Door Opens by Itself
immediate: The player at Ellie & Luca's House loses 2 Sanity. (If empty: skip.)

title: An Old Friend Drops By
art_notes: Knock on a door with a stranger silhouette

title: Blood Moon Rising
ongoing: Until next Dawn: Threat draws +1 at all locations.
art_notes: A red moon over the cul-de-sac

title: The Walls Are Bleeding
immediate: Each player at a house tile loses 2 Sanity.

title: A Box on the Porch
immediate: Add 1 Metal and 1 Cloth to the nearest house tile. Also draw 1 Threat there.
art_notes: A cardboard box with something moving inside

title: Every Mirror Cracked
immediate: All players discard 1 Battery (if held). The player with the most items loses 1 Sanity.
art_notes: Spiderweb cracks across a bathroom mirror

title: Someone Waves from the End of the Street
immediate: All players at sport courts lose 2 Sanity.
ongoing: Until next Dawn: movement to or from sport courts costs +1 Hunger.
art_notes: A figure waving slowly in the distance with the wrong number of fingers

title: The Rain Starts and Won't Stop
immediate: All outdoor locations (sport courts) have Gather actions cost +1 Sanity this day.
ongoing: Until next Dawn: Fire light sources are extinguished at sport courts.
art_notes: Heavy rain streaking past a streetlight
